messages:
maria_support: FYI support case from ACME (bob) — after last night's rollout their app is getting responses with no tool calls. customer says it used to call `create_order` and now it's silent. can we triage?

bob_acme: @maria_support yep — started ~00:15 UTC after the variant swap. previously we saw a `tool_call` object in the model output; now it's just free text. no errors on our side. :frowning: 

maria_support: copying paste of their request/response below. request is the same prompt we used in internal repro.

bob_acme: REQUEST:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "rwd-infer-2b:v3",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"user","content":"Create order for 3 widgets, shipping to 123 Pine St, include order_id: 9876"}
  ],
  "tools": ["create_order"]
}
```
RESPONSE (now):
```
200 OK
{
  "id": "resp_abc",
  "choices": [
    {"message": {"role":"assistant","content":"Order created. Tracking soon."}}
  ]
}
```
EXPECTED (before rollout):
```
{
  "choices": [
    {"message": {"role":"assistant","tool_call": {"name":"create_order","arguments":"{"order_id":9876,"qty":3,"addr":"123 Pine St"}"}}}
  ]
}
```

maria_support: customer also attached a short log — they see a 200 and the token stream seems fine. so it's not an HTTP error.

deploy-bot: Canary variant "rwd-infer-2b:v3-variant-b" promoted at 1984310600 (auto-canary).

alex_eng_platform: thanks — tagging eng-ml. @jordan_eng_ml can you take a look at the model->toolcall routing? looks like the tool invocation signal is being dropped or the assistant is switching to plain text output.

jordan_eng_ml: on it. quick Q: can you confirm whether this is happening for all requests or just the customer's prompts? any prompt truncation or tokenization differences?

bob_acme: we've tried a few prompts — deterministic prompt they used to rely on — all now return text only. happens both with and without streaming.

jordan_eng_ml: can you dump the raw assistant output proto (the internal JSON before post-processing) and the model logits if possible? also include model variant id and inference config (kv cache, quant) used for those requests.

maria_support: I'll ask customer for the raw dump. for our internal repro I ran the same prompt against the older variant (v3-variant-a) and confirmed a tool_call appears. running against the new variant yields no tool_call. attaching quick diff.

maria_support: DIFF:
```
variant-a: ... "tool_call":{"name":"create_order","arguments":"{...}"} ...
variant-b: ... "message":{"content":"Order created. Tracking soon."} ...
```

jordan_eng_ml: interesting — two possibilities off the top: 1) the model weights/decoding config in variant-b were recompiled with a different special-token behavior so the system token that signals tool calls is being dropped; 2) runtime post-processing that maps special tokens -> tool_call object failed (e.g., regex or JSON parse changed). Can you share the inference config and tokenizer version?

alex_eng_platform: adding note: we also changed the streaming prefix handling in the platform at 1984310400 to reduce latency. could be related (we strip out some control tokens earlier).

sara_support: customer asks for a rollback if it's high risk for them — can we gate that?

jordan_eng_ml: next steps from eng-ml: 1) get one verified raw model output blob from the customer's failing request (pre-routing). 2) run the same input through the older variant binary and new variant binary with identical decode/hparams. 3) compare the token sequence for special tool-call markers. If missing in variant-b, it's a model/compile regression. If present but not surfaced, it's platform post-processing.

maria_support: bob_acme provided the raw output blob: attaching (pasted).

bob_acme: RAW_BLOB:
```
[102, 3456, 12, 9981, 404, 999, 4321, 77, 88]
```
(we know this is not human-friendly; customer said their team recorded the token ids).

jordan_eng_ml: token ids ok as a start. need the tokenizer mapping. maria, can you get the request id & model variant id from their headers so we can pull the full inference trace from our traces?

maria_support: request-id: req_0x9f4b, model-variant: rwd-infer-2b:v3-variant-b, region: us-west-2. forwarded to eng-ml.

alex_eng_platform: I pulled trace req_0x9f4b — I see the runtime emitted a partial assistant proto with a field `control_seq` present in variant-a runs but missing in variant-b. suspects: kernel selection changed control token mapping. pushing to eng-runtime and eng-ml.

jordan_eng_ml: on hypothesis 1: if variant-b was recompiled with a different tokenizer special-case, we should see the raw logits around the tool-call boundary differ. I'll diff logits between variants for req_0x9f4b. may take ~30m.

sara_support: can we offer ACME a temporary mitigation? they need tool calls for order automation.

alex_eng_platform: short-term mitigation: route their tenant to dedicated variant-a pool (we can pin their account to variant-a for the next 24h) while we investigate. requires ops approval for a manual routing rule. @deploy-bot can you schedule a route?

deploy-bot: Routing change request opened: route-acme-req-0x9f4b -> rwd-infer-2b:v3-variant-a (expires +24h). Needs approval from oncall.

maria_support: thanks team. next updates after eng-ml diffs. I'll also ask customer to escalate to support SLA level for faster turnaround. :pray:
